reviews.comment: The class is very easy, but grading feels inconsistent with no clear rubrics. I often lost points despite explicitely answering problems correctly or non-listed items. Lectures are bland and unhelpful, and the TA is hard to follow. Attendance is required, and labs may be canceled or moved online, leading to stacked assignments.

Very small class, Behnia has an accent which was hard to understand at times. Most weeks we would meet for maybe 20-30 minutes while she outlined what to do in the lab, then she took attendance and we could leave. Most tedious part was entering weather data for the semester long project, besides that most labs take 30 minutes to do at home.

This is the most tedious one hour course you will take. 15 page labs, 800 word essays, group projects, individual project checkpoints, graphs, tables, and it just goes on and on. Too much for one credit hour. This is not Marjan's fault, and she is very sweet and does her best to make the course fun. Super light grader too.

The class was somewhat easy but at times, felt unnecessary. The assignments and lecture feel like busy work and can feel repetitious at times. Professor Behnia is a good professor but is not helpful at times. The class meets once a week and some of the assignments require you to be in class to obtain the data.
